name: Folsom
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Folsom for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (Community Christmas Tree Lighting) through December 22 (Wild Nights and Holiday Lights), with Santa's Whistlestop Adventure Train (December 6 to 21) along the way, and the Historic Folsom Ice Rink open through January 18, 2027. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Folsom

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Folsom
  • 2 free events: the Community Christmas Tree Lighting and free pictures with Santa
  • Meet Santa: the tree lighting, free pictures with Santa and Santa's Whistlestop Adventure Train
  • Trains: Santa's Whistlestop Adventure Train and the Folsom Valley Railway miniature train at Wild Nights and Holiday Lights
  • Lights: Wild Nights and Holiday Lights at the Folsom Zoo Sanctuary
  • Season: December 4, 2026 to December 22, 2026, plus the ice rink through January 18, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Folsom families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Sacramento, which covers Imaginarium at Cal Expo, Theatre of Lights and the Old Sacramento Tree Lighting.
